column1: # Search glossary: Estonian to English (ADR 0048). Written for Otos from Vision's scene-label
# names, the vocabulary search already reads photos with, then common words of a photo
# search (below). A line is an English reading, then
# the Estonian forms that mean it: nominative, then genitive (the stem compounds and case
# endings build on). Where a form means several readings, the one it is listed earlier for wins.
